## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll to '...'
4. See the error

## Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen instead.

## Actual behaviour

What actually happens. Console output, screenshots, or screen recordings help.

## Environment

- Device:           <!-- e.g. iPhone 15 Pro, Pixel 8, MacBook Air M2 -->
- OS / version:     <!-- e.g. iOS 18.2, Android 15, macOS 14.5 -->
- Browser / version: <!-- e.g. Safari 18, Chrome 130 -->
- App version / commit: <!-- from About / footer / git SHA -->
- Locale:           <!-- ar / de -->
- Theme:            <!-- light / dark / system -->

## Additional context

Anything else: related routes, network conditions, account type, recent changes.
